title: Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Brussels Sprouts

items.prep: peeled and chopped into 1-2 inch pieces

instructions: Trim the brussels sprouts by cutting off the little brown ends; pull off any yellow leaves. Cut any large ones in half and add to a large bowl.
Peel the sweet potato and chop into 1-2 inch pieces; add to the bowl.
Smash 2 cloves of garlic and add to the bowl.
Pour the olive oil over the vegetables, add the cumin, garlic powder, salt, and pepper to taste, and stir to coat.
Line a large sheet pan with foil and drizzle a little olive oil on it, rubbing it all over (or spray well with nonstick spray). Pour the veggies onto the pan.
Roast at 400°F for about 15 minutes — the veggies are done when browned and a fork slides in easily.
Transfer to a serving bowl and toss with 1-2 tablespoons of red wine vinegar to taste.
notes: Doc updated: oil ⅓ cup → ¼ cup, cumin 1 tsp → ¾ tsp, garlic salt → ¼ tsp garlic powder, salt 1 tsp → ¼ tsp, roast time 30-40 min → 15 min.
